text_markup: Some effects host multiple cards on an object at the same time or set aside multiple cards at the same time. Facedown cards that enter a zone at the same time by the same effect are treated as a group. See {ref:rule_host_faceup_facedown} and {ref:rule_facedown_set_aside_distinct_groups}, respectively.
text_plain: Some effects host multiple cards on an object at the same time or set aside multiple cards at the same time. Facedown cards that enter a zone at the same time by the same effect are treated as a group. See section 1.13.7 and rule 4.8.7, respectively.
